Pose: standing side-on in a formal fencing stance, wooden sword held vertically in front, other paw behind the back

It stands (or rests) on the ground with its feet at the very bottom edge of the picture - do not draw it floating.

Output 768x768 PNG. Save the image as monster_white_duelist_idle.png in the current directory and report the path.
